notes.text: Ritual (74) and GenLayer (70) are closest to the bar; each still needs a dated TGE and a published audit, and GenLayer an official Arbitrum contract.
DAC's Nov 22 TGE is reported by many accounts but not posted by @dac_chain; a second missed date already left it at REJECT.
Abelian's +24% came on about $59k volume (range $0.091 to $0.150); treat it as a thin-book move.
Before an official contract, any token named GenLayer, Ritual, Fraction, Dataline, Pond or Flop is a scam.
Crynux (CNX/USDT) no longer appears in SafeTrade tickers on CoinGecko; its DEX route is Uniswap V4 on Base (thin).

Tier comes from the Oracle Score (75+ Strong, 55 to 74 Watch, under 55 Speculative). It does not reflect market cap, and "No DEX" only means there is no official DEX route, not that a project is low quality.

Pearl (PRL) has no official DEX route. The Uniswap WPRL token comes from a third-party bridge and the Solana "PEARL" pools showing tens of millions are fakes. Its $644M market cap is circulating; fully diluted value is about $3.8B.
DATA Network is the renamed Story Protocol token (a16z-backed; Upbit, OKX, Coinbase, Kraken). It is not Streamr DATA. Nearly all volume is on exchanges and it has no official DEX.

Gonka: price and DEX row use the official WGNK bridge on Uniswap; the SafeTrade pair is native GNK. Axis volume was $191M during the Binance Alpha competition and is about $75M now; its fully diluted value is about 6x market cap. Clore (about $23k DEX liquidity) and Crynux are thin.
Tier comes from the Oracle Score, not market cap. QRL and Abelian have no DEX because QRL and ABEL tokens on Base or Solana are impostors; Abelian also trades on only one exchange (MEXC).

Quantus market cap is $23M but fully diluted value is about $435M; its DEX route is the bridged qtc.omft.near on Rhea (NEAR), which Quantus documents. Algorand trades about 99.8% on exchanges; its DEX route is Tinyman v2 ALGO/USDC (about $1.6M liquidity).
Neptune Cash has no official DEX: wNPT on Base is SafeTrade's own wrapper. Cellframe's real DEX route is PancakeSwap v3 on BSC; the Uniswap v2 Ethereum pool is mispriced and nearly unused.
